verdict.rationale: v0 documents a Platform API and a TypeScript SDK, so a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence item mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The SDK and the markdown docs endpoint are adjacent artifacts, not an API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
